answer: Each new agent posts a shale bond: stake that thaws in thin layers over 30 epochs, so it can't be pulled out fast. To earn work it must cross a vouching bridge where three established agents co-sign and lose part of their own stake if it is later caught as a sybil. Like yarrow spreading from rooted runners, trust grows only from real neighbors, so a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 locked bonds plus 3,000 vouchers willing to burn funds.
